resources.string: The host Xlorie renderer is configured separately. XFCE uses its default container environment; independent container GPU acceleration is not configured.

KWin runs on the host; Plasma Shell runs inside Debian. Choose System EGL or Zink for the host, and LLVMpipe or Zink for the container independently. Zink requires a working Vulkan backend; software Vulkan uses the CPU.
This host and container renderer pair is unsupported. Check the supported pairs shown above; both selections must be set explicitly.
Xlorie uses System EGL on the host. Ubuntu GNOME uses software rendering inside Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; container GPU acceleration, USB storage and backup are not yet supported.
Ubuntu style · Native GNOME. Yaru theme, left Dock, system tray and desktop icons. Uses Android System EGL; runs native Termux applications.
